_note: Prompt-only catalog (REF_MODE=text, the default): one hair_prompt per style and no reference photos. REF_MODE=ref additionally needs a `reference` image file per style. To add a style: add an entry here (id, gender, length, name, hair_prompt), add its tile to the app style list and rebuild.

styles.name: French bob
styles.hair_prompt: a Parisian French bob ending at the chin, soft rounded ends tucked in slightly, an airy lightweight texture and a short see-through fringe

styles.name: Bixie cut
styles.hair_prompt: a short layered bixie: the back and nape cut short and tapered, the front and sides longer at the cheekbones and jaw, soft textured layers on top with a side part

styles.name: Italian bob
styles.hair_prompt: a voluminous jaw-length Italian bob with blunt ends that flick softly outward, full body and soft movement, a slightly off-center part, no bangs

styles.name: Collarbone lob
styles.hair_prompt: a straight lob ending just above the collarbone, the ends cut bluntly, with soft face-framing pieces at the front and a gentle side part, natural movement

styles.name: Layered shoulder
styles.hair_prompt: layered shoulder-length hair with soft layers and a center part

styles.name: Shag cut
styles.hair_prompt: a shoulder-length shag with soft layers starting at the cheekbones, airy volume on top, thick full curtain bangs parted in the center and flowing to both sides in two wide curtains that frame the face past the eyebrows, loose lightweight texture at the ends

styles.name: C-curl layers
styles.hair_prompt: a long layered cut ending on the upper chest with inward-curved ends: the ends roll under and in toward the neck in a clean C shape, the front layers curve inward toward the cheeks, soft side-swept bangs, smooth and silky

styles.name: Butterfly cut
styles.hair_prompt: long chest-length hair in a butterfly cut: short face-framing layers from the cheekbones that sweep back and outward, long feathered layers below with airy volume and softly flicked ends, a slightly off-center part

styles.name: Curtain layers
styles.hair_prompt: long soft layers falling past the shoulders to the chest, thick curtain bangs with plenty of hair parted in the middle and sweeping to each side to the cheekbones, face-framing layers blending into the length, a smooth natural finish

styles.name: Voluminous waves
styles.hair_prompt: very long voluminous layered hair past the chest with big soft bouncy waves, side-swept face-framing layers that fall forward over the cheeks and partly cover the sides of the face, lots of lift at the crown, long feathered layers ending in soft outward flicks, a deep side part

styles.name: Buzz cut
styles.hair_prompt: a very short buzz cut

styles.name: Low fade
styles.hair_prompt: a modern low skin fade with a soft natural hairline and a short tousled textured top

styles.name: French crop
styles.hair_prompt: a very short textured crop with a skin fade, the top cut about two centimetres long with choppy layered texture, a short fringe forward and cut straight across just above the eyebrows, tight faded sides

styles.name: Ivy League
styles.hair_prompt: a classic Ivy League side part: a defined part line on one side, the top combed back and across in smooth neat comb lines with a light pomade shine, short tapered sides and back, ears visible

styles.name: Two-block
styles.hair_prompt: a modern two-block cut: tight skin-faded sides and back from the temples down, ears exposed, a thick heavy top with soft choppy layers falling forward into a short fringe just above the eyebrows

styles.name: Modern quiff
styles.hair_prompt: a modern quiff with a low fade: tight low-faded sides with ears visible, and a textured top with moderate natural lift at the front, soft layers swept back and slightly up, an everyday wearable volume

styles.name: Shadow perm
styles.hair_prompt: a shadow perm: short tapered sides with the ears visible, and a soft curly textured top with loose wavy curls falling forward into a short fringe just above the eyebrows, natural airy volume

styles.name: Leaf cut
styles.hair_prompt: a men's leaf cut: soft layered medium-length hair swept down and out to both sides from a light part, a see-through fringe above the eyebrows, loose natural waves at the ends, tapered back

styles.name: Curtains
styles.hair_prompt: a curtain haircut with a middle part: the top medium length with natural volume and loose waves, parting down the center and sweeping to each side over the temples, tapered sides tucked at the ears, a soft tapered back

styles.name: Mullet
styles.hair_prompt: a soft modern mullet with tapered sides and ears showing, loose messy waves on top falling into a short fringe above the eyebrows, the back kept short and slightly longer than the sides, soft wavy ends touching the nape of the neck
